author: Andrews7
quote: In my opinion, the game draws its appeal primarily from its history and nostalgia. I understand that it has cult status for many players, but from today's perspective, I don't see anything exceptional about it. As far as I'm concerned, it's a highly overrated title.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: Andrews7
